messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 [AUTO] Region health oscillation detected: rapid probe failures and fallbacks observed between us-east -> us-west -> eu starting at 2026-03-15T03:24:36Z. Abnormal retry/backoff pattern, potential routing policy loop. Pager triggered for SRE oncall.

alice-nguyen: I’m on it — paging @sre-oncall. Seeing spike in client 42 (prod) errors and elevated tail latency.

sre-oncall: Got the page, jumping in. Can someone dump the recent health probe timeline?

maria-gonzalez: Pasted short log snippet from router telemetry: 
```
2026-03-15T03:24:30Z route-check us-east -> healthy
2026-03-15T03:24:33Z probe us-east FAILED (502)
2026-03-15T03:24:34Z fallback to us-west
2026-03-15T03:24:36Z probe us-west FAILED (timeout)
2026-03-15T03:24:37Z fallback to eu
2026-03-15T03:24:38Z probe eu OK
2026-03-15T03:24:39Z probe eu FAILED (latency spike)
2026-03-15T03:24:40Z fallback to us-east
...
```
This pattern repeats ~20x in 2m.

raj-patel: Hmm looks like health-check hysteresis isn’t applied for this probe group. Config shows aggressive sensitivity for model-serving routes.

alice-nguyen: Confirming: routing policy for model-variant fallback set to immediate failover (0 retries, no grace). That matches the sawtooth.

sre-oncall: Customer impact? Which tenants hit errors vs only increased latency?

maria-gonzalez: Most traffic is still served but we’re seeing 5xx spike for prod API keys: ~0.8% of requests 5xx from 03:24:30-03:26:00. A subset of requests saw long tails (1-3s extra).

product-oncall: @alice-nguyen can we surface this to a couple of impacted customers (platform partners)? They’ll notice 5xx.

alice-nguyen: Yes, I'll notify the top-3 impacted accounts via the incident template after we stabilize.

sre-oncall: Immediate mitigation: disable cross-region immediate fallback policy for the affected route group (switch to region-priority with 10s grace/hysteresis). Who can flip the policy now?

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline shows no active deployments. ACL allows alice-nguyen or raj-patel to change runtime routing.

raj-patel: I can flip, doing a config patch to add `min_fail_seconds: 10` and `max_retries: 2` for probe group `model-serving/priority`. Pushing change to canary first.

alice-nguyen: Before patch—let's add a temporary throttle to avoid cascading retries. Set `fallback_cooldown: 15s`.

raj-patel: Applying change to canary control plane now. Command: `krakenctl apply -f routing-patch.yaml --env prod --canary`

deploy-bot: Canary config applied to 2 control-plane hosts in us-east. Monitoring health.

maria-gonzalez: Early signals: sawtooth reduces in canary region within 30s. us-east still noisy (old policy).

sre-oncall: Good. Roll the patch to global if no regressions in 90s. Keep an eye on probing errors.

(90s later)

raj-patel: Rolling to global: `krakenctl rollout routing-patch --to prod`

deploy-bot: Rollout started. Target: all regions (us-east, us-west, eu). Progress: 0/12 hosts updated.

maria-gonzalez: Telemetry: 1m after global rollout — 5xx rate back down to baseline (~0.05%), tail latency normalized. No customer escalations yet.

product-oncall: Sending heads-up notes now to impacted accounts: "We observed transient errors tied to cross-region health checks; mitigation applied; monitoring active. Follow-up postmortem will be shared."

alice-nguyen: Pushing a short-term checklist: 1) keep policy in conservative mode for 24h, 2) increase probe hysteresis by default for model-serving routes, 3) create alert for >3 region-fallbacks/min per route.

sre-oncall: Agreed. We also need an emergency patch to the routing engine to reject circular failovers when the same three regions flip within 30s. Filing a high-priority ticket.

raj-patel: Ticket created: RD-12891 "Prevent triple-hop regional failover loops via probe hysteresis + loop detection". Assigning to eng-runtime.

maria-gonzalez: Noting the root cause candidate: an overly-aggressive health threshold combined with asymmetric probe timings across regions. On us-east we had a transient 502 spike from the local load balancer which immediately triggered fallback; other regions then saw elevated latency due to sudden traffic bursts and their probes tripped, causing hop chain.

alice-nguyen: Post-incident actions (short): 
- patch routing defaults (hysteresis)
- add per-route loop detector with cooldown
- update runbook to include immediate policy flip steps + customer comms template
- postmortem scheduled 2026-03-15T10:00Z

product-oncall: I'll own customer comms and timeline. @maria-gonzalez can you capture the probe traces for the postmortem?

maria-gonzalez: Will export probe traces + control-plane logs and put in the incident doc.

sre-oncall: Closing pager for now — system stable and metrics green for 10m. If sawtooth starts again reopen. Great response, team. :clap:

alice-nguyen: Thanks everyone. Logging this thread into the incidents tracker and linking RD-12891.

incident-bot: Incident auto-summary created: "Transient cross-region health-check oscillation caused short-lived fallback loops across us-east/us-west/eu. Mitigation: adjusted routing hysteresis and cooldown; global config rolled out. Impact: brief 5xx spike ~0.8% affecting a subset of prod traffic. Follow-up: RD-12891, postmortem 2026-03-15T10:00Z."

alice-nguyen: Closing thread."
